generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.level_2: 评估器驱动的算子演进 — Evaluator-Driven Operator Evolution
feature.description: Produces versioned improvement candidates, tests and benchmarks them, compares quality/cost/risk trade-offs, and supports approval, promotion and rollback. It should evolve definitions, profiles and binding policies—not silently rewrite an operator through “reflection”.

contract.purpose_user_function: Generate and evaluate versioned operator/profile/binding-policy improvements under approval and rollback controls.
contract.valid_inputs: Operator failures/profiles, evaluator verdicts, proposed definition/policy change, benchmark/eval pack, risk/cost comparison, and approval.
contract.expected_outputs: Improvement recommendation/candidate, evaluation scorecard, promotion/demotion decision, and rollback evidence.
contract.state_side_effects: May persist evolution records and update approved skill/capability state; operator definitions are not silently rewritten by routing.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Failed regression/evaluation, insufficient evidence, policy or approval denial, higher risk/cost, or incompatible version blocks promotion.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Generic evolution and scorecards exist; a dedicated end-to-end operator-definition evolution subsystem is partial.
contract.success_evidence: Before/after evidence and approval-gated decision exist; failed candidate leaves active operator/binding unchanged.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: candidate proposed; benchmark pass/fail; cost-risk trade-off; approval; promote; rollback; no silent mutation.
contract.readme_product_docs: docs/solar-architecture-code-map.md §§2-4 Actor/host, logical operators, physical runtime; docs/migration-physical-operators-to-actor-hosts.md
contract.cli_api_skill_interfaces: harness/lib/logical_operator_registry.py; harness/lib/logical_operator_router.py: LogicalOperatorRouter; harness/lib/operator_runtime.py: submit(), write_heartbeat(), write_result(); harness/tools/pm_dispatch.py
contract.config_schemas: harness/config/logical-operators.json and logical-operators.schema.json; harness/config/physical-operators.json and physical-operators.schema.json; harness/config/agent-actors.json; harness/config/actor-hosts.json
contract.implementation_entrypoints: harness/lib/evolution_engine.py: recommend(), run_loop(), promote(), demote_degraded(); core/nerve/evolution-engine.ts: EvolutionEngine
contract.platform_provider_limitations: Selection logic is local Python, while physical execution depends on configured tmux/Claude/Codex/browser/local-process/remote hosts, subscriptions, credentials, health, and quota.
